answer: Sybil resistance works through bonded registration: each operator posts a stake plus a per-wallet proof of work, so a hundred fake identities need a hundred separate bond deposits and proofs, not one free account. Swarm votes then split the same payout while a delta penalty hits duplicate behavior, turning profit negative. An attacker pays capital, compute, and a walnut-grade key per identity, which is the copper floor the network relies on.
